newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Aer Lingus, Lufthansa subsidiaries discuss alliance.
newsitem.headline: Aer Lingus, Lufthansa subsidiaries discuss alliance.

text.p: Irish national carrier Aer Lingus said on Thursday it was in talks with Germany's Lufthansa on forming a strategic alliance between the two airlines' aircraft overhaul businesses.
The strategic alliance involves Lufthansa Technik taking a majority shareholding in Aer Lingus' Airmotive Ireland.

"The objective of this alliance is in line with the Aer Lingus objective of developing Airmotive Ireland in the context of a strategic relationship with a partner of world class stature," Aer Lingus said.
It said Lufthansa Technik was among the world's largest providers of technical services for aircraft operators.
